name: glocommerce
description: MERN storefront and admin dashboard. Cash-on-delivery only.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix client run test && npm --prefix server run test
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
